title: SciGame: Let Agents Play the Scientific Discovery Games in the Real and Counterfactual World
abstract: arXiv:2610.37919v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language model agents are increasingly used for scientific discovery. However, existing benchmarks mix law inference with programming, score data fitting instead of prediction on unseen inputs, and do not separate empirical evidence from pretrained priors. We introduce SciGame, a controlled benchmark that converts scientific literature into structured scientific cards. Each card yields a pair of Original and dimensionally consistent Counterfactual environments with the same task interface. SciGame contains a Historical collection of canonical laws and a live Temporal collection curated from papers published after model knowledge cutoffs. It evaluates agents in candidate-guided Identification and open-ended Discovery settings. Each setting runs under Prior-only, Fixed, and Adaptive protocols. Experiments on five frontier models yield three findings. First, familiar priors hurt performance once the governing relation is altered. Seco

translated_title: SciGame：让智能体在真实与反事实世界中游玩科学发现游戏
translated_abstract: 大语言模型智能体正越来越多地被用于科学发现。然而，现有的基准测试将定律推理与编程混合在一起，用分数来衡量数据拟合而非对未见输入的预测能力，并且未能将经验证据与预训练先验区分开来。我们提出了 SciGame，这是一个受控基准，它将科学文献转换为结构化的科学卡片。每张卡片生成一对具有相同任务界面的“原始”环境与维度一致的“反事实”环境。SciGame 包含一个由经典定律组成的“历史”集合，以及一个从模型知识截止日期之后发表的论文中精选的实时“时间”集合。该基准在候选引导的“辨识”和开放式“发现”两种设置下评估智能体，且每种设置均在“仅先验”、“固定”和“自适应”三种协议下运行。在五个前沿模型上的实验得出了三个发现：第一，一旦支配关系被改变，熟悉的先验反而会损害性能……
tldr: SciGame 是一个受控科学发现基准，通过将科学文献转化为包含“原始-反事实”环境对的结构化科学卡片，并结合历史与时间集合、多种任务设置与评估协议，实现了对大语言模型智能体科学发现能力中先验知识与经验证据的严格分离评估。
en_tdlr: SciGame is a controlled benchmark that converts scientific literature into structured scientific cards with paired Original and Counterfactual environments, evaluating LLM agents' scientific discovery under Identification and Discovery settings to rigorously separate pretrained priors from empirical evidence.
